scope: Node domain and CPU raster baseline; no UI/controller, WebGL upload, presented-frame or native physical-memory budget claim.
method: Two fresh processes per complete golden-verified background and size. Two extra overlapping striped layers with 25% holes, registered stone, identical raw stone, and alpha-zero paint; source 512x384 or 1024x768 crosses 32/64 boundaries. CW+horizontal transpose then offset (3,5), one atomic commit. CPU preview raster covers all six layers in a 1024x640 CSS detail viewport. Timings exclude GC and correctness checks. Retained snapshots and plans remain alive through history eviction, isolating released history approximately. heapUsed+arrayBuffers is a V8 estimate, external already includes buffers; snapshots are not a transient heap peak and maxRSS is whole-process high-water including load/verification. Two samples are not percentiles. House samples are 20 resets per scope with full document hash checks, separate CPU timing only. Performance gate deferred to TW-049/TW-050.
